name: What is the typical timeline for a room addition project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a room addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room addition project generally spans several months, from initial design to final inspection. The design and permitting phase can take 1-3 months, depending on the project's complexity and local municipality review times. Construction itself typically takes 3-6 months, influenced by the addition's size, weather conditions, material availability, and the efficiency of the crew. Larger or more complex additions may require longer. Your contractor should provide a detailed project schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical room addition project can take 4-9 months, with 1-3 months for design and permitting, and 3-6 months for construction.
